Keep right sword, right hand, existing rear-pommel-to-post cyan line and BOTH endpoints exactly; keep face, body landing pose, footwear, composition, city, lighting, dimensions and all existing objects. Do not add another line or move its endpoint onto blade. Also preserve the already-torn lower jacket hem as a small uneven triangular missing notch, not a new large wound.
